notes:
更新内容：
- chore: 发布 4.2.9 (a2edfdb)
- feat: root 与 Shizuku 串成一条链，su 不通就自动落到 Shizuku，不用用户选 (b82cc0a)
- fix: su 用查到的绝对路径执行，PATH 里没有时不再把「找不到命令」当成没授权 (b428dca)
- fix: 身份绑定就带上机型，有型号覆盖率不再只等于开过社区页的人数 (3b63b92)
- fix: 迁移按文件名先后被拒时用 --include-all，并行写迁移不再卡住 db push (d9a277e)
- fix: 机型芯片显示编号的，先读厂商 market.name 属性，再靠 device_names 表兜底 (bbced36)
- fix: 门槛降到 45 后，空条目的缺票数断言跟着改 (971b94e)
- feat: 设置页写明当前走的是 root 还是 Stellar/Shizuku (3d2ecec)
- feat: 推荐条目重新分类、本站推荐置顶四条，投票门槛 50 降到 45 票 (5dfa2fa)
- feat: 消息中心四栏各自记已读，点开一栏不再清掉其它栏的红点 (394ed1e)
- feat: 停用批次也能整批回滚，停用/恢复批次被打断也能续跑 (230d453)
- feat: 推荐页恢复两个页签（列表/投票），条目能指回本机还装着的包 (aa77f22)
- fix: 占用探测抽成共用探针，root 路径下同样拦桌面/键盘/管理员/无障碍 (9bab116)
- fix: 被占用拦下的包也要带上规则说的理由，一个包只列一次 (005064a)
- fix: 占用判定只认默认键盘，被拦的包不再同时出现在风险清单里 (065b82a)
- feat: 后端加 healthz RPC，能分清地址不通和迁移没跑 (63124bc)
- feat: 卸前拦住正在当桌面/键盘/设备管理员/无障碍的包 (e34c08e)
- fix: 安全规则弹框构造改挂起，deviceProfile 不能从普通函数调用 (a00b599)
- feat: 推荐页收回成单页——推荐入口与投票队列直接排在精选列表之上 (6cf2ed9)
- fix: 关掉卸载前确认不再连带关掉设备安全规则 (cdb1d8a)
- fix: 补回重写时漏掉的 AppGridCell (9b2c873)
- feat: 推荐页拆成「精选/社区」两页签，列表只留名字，社区行内做小号投票 (c109d00)
- fix: root only reports authorized once the grant has actually been given (d1f68c5)
- fix: 把桌面/Web 的 actual 移出 adb 组，Android 加进 adb 后不再撞同名 actual (28f31d7)
- fix: 接受裸 owner/repo 形式，推荐表单不再拒掉复制来的项目路径 (aa9f1fe)
- feat: 推荐页记住排列方式、不重复作者行，并加入社区推荐与投票审核 (960630d)
- fix: put the android target in the adb source set (5129877)
- feat: name root as the privilege in the setup pages (6adddec)
- chore: 发布 4.2.8 (1066b69)
- feat: 下载页逐版本更新日志，发版说明改为提交清单 (80b24de)
- feat: work through root instead of Shizuku on a rooted phone (8443f13)
- fix: 补 CommentThread 缺失的 PlayArrow import，修复 compileAndroidMain (5b9fc01)
- feat: comment list typography, reply arrow, batches of replies; share code read once (62bdc1b)
- fix: 下载页开发版更新时间改用 APK 资产上传时间，滚动 release 的 published_at 停在首发 (98f5133)
- fix: import UploaderProfileScreen where the route uses it (3805d57)
- test: an unrecorded ROM reads as Android, not as nothing (facb98a)
- feat: give an uploader a page of their own (410118c)
- fix: comment_like 的局部变量改名，评论点赞报 42702 从不落库 (c92b71d)
- fix: 应用详情的评论按身份读取，点赞不再每次显示未赞 (42c0922)
- fix: pass coverage through the plan page and import JsonPrimitive (f8ec86d)
- feat: show which other phones a plan's package set survived on (c26665d)
- feat: search the recommended apps, package names included (a508427)
- feat: open a page on the comment that was mentioned (1d8384a)
- fix: PlanHero takes the note-editor callback with the note (75bb260)
- fix: give the note editor a callback instead of reaching into page state (5600a7d)
- feat: split the inbox into reply, plan-comment and heart tabs (887b67e)
- fix: only clear the red dot when the seen cursor really moved (64c392c)
- fix(migrations): give the inbox cursor its own version number (001da29)
- feat: let the uploader rewrite a plan's note (b48202e)
- feat: show the comment length limit instead of truncating silently (1472bd0)
- feat: switch the comment order between newest, most hearted and most useful (1401178)
- test: expect the freeze option in the confirm dialog (044e4fb)
- fix: import the freeze strings where they are used (10ad919)
- feat: keep a comment draft when the page is left (5001640)
- fix: import STATUS_NEGATIVE_RESPONSE in PackageOperations (034702f)
- feat: separate freezing from uninstalling (b506c6b)
- fix: import emptyFlow for the new disable default (71db355)
- fix: read the interrupted batch without runCatching around suspend calls (84cda54)
- feat: resume an uninstall batch that was cut short (c760be2)
- test: fix the failure-explanation assertions (ffeab3e)
- feat: undo a whole uninstall batch in one tap (214f9fc)
- feat: snapshot package state before uninstall (62f40f5)
- feat: human-readable uninstall failure reasons (74cae49)
- fix: 切换栏内边距改用四向重载，修 compileKotlinDesktop 失败 (fe6552c)
- feat: 切换栏加搜索按钮，按包名过滤方案与排行列表 (f5f4fbe)
- feat: 机型选择器加搜索，切换栏加放大镜入口 (b171483)
- fix: 折线爱心内缩到跟左侧爱心一样大，表情面板改成点页面空白处收起 (90d882c)
- fix: 方案详情的重启验证行显示上传者的机型与系统版本，不再借用本机 (cc79f87)
- fix: 红点按已读游标计数，看完消息不再一直挂着 (1bc84be)
- feat: 折叠评论的图标改成手绘的爱心加一道细折线，替掉闪电 (6bf36d6)
- fix: 可用性探测的超时分支补回 Boolean，修 runCatching 推断成 Boolean? 的编译错误 (59785fd)
- feat: 推荐方案里 @名字后面补上真实机型，未改名时设置页淡黄色慢速呼吸提示改名 (97ff53d)
- feat: add WiFiAnalyzer to the recommended apps catalog (ffe948a)
- feat(plans): check the connection before and after an upload (7dc3429)
- feat(plans): add an all-models scope and make it the default ranking (7a91dc4)
- fix: 输入框改用透明文本框叠表情文本（BasicTextField 不支持内联图），并修面板高度取值的接收者 (d42e33c)
- fix(plans): stop the upload sheet bouncing while its list scrolls (ea1a1ce)
- fix: 输入框里直接把表情画成图（粘贴 [偷笑] 自动变成表情），顶部输入框不再被面板盖住，token 用中文名 (0760877)
- feat(bloat): ship a fallback copy of the UAD list for phones that cannot reach GitHub (8b1ab19)
- feat(plans): upload as a bottom sheet behind the reboot check (6ba2b0c)
- feat: 更新渠道默认走开发版，未选择过渠道的安装跟滚动 dev 构建 (352dd41)
- fix: appendInlineContent 改为 foundation 包下的扩展，修表情内联渲染编译 (ab52451)
- fix: 表情内联占位改用 sp 并显式导入 appendInlineContent，修云端编译 (8c44daf)
- feat: 评论栏加上抖音表情面板，点赞数移到右侧、不喜欢换成单道闪电、折叠正文带展开动画 (04298e0)
- fix: 钉钉消息末尾改用实际关键词 rr (5585059)
- ci: 每天把总人数与有型号人数推到钉钉 (906d0a6)
- feat: 开发版在下载页和关于页显示 build 号，与同版本号的稳定版区分开 (cc29647)
- feat: 下载页默认选中开发版（迭代更快），开发版暂无产物时自动退回稳定版 (2662cea)
